US Indo-Pacific Commander Visits India for Defense Talks

Admiral Samuel J. Paparo, Commander of the US Indo-Pacific Command, is in Delhi for his second visit to India this year. He has met with the Chief of Defence Staff and other senior military leaders. The visit continues a series of high-level defense engagements between the United States and India aimed at deepening defense ties.
